desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on US naval movements in the Indo-Pacific, localized ceasefires and evacuations in Ukraine’s Kherson Oblast, and scattered drone/pipeline incidents. The single most important thread is the USS Theodore Roosevelt’s Singapore port call delaying its CENTCOM arrival until mid-November.

## MAIN THREADS

### USS Roosevelt Singapore Port Call
- @sentdefender and @BarakRavid both report a U.S. official confirming the carrier will spend several days in Singapore starting tomorrow before reaching CENTCOM no earlier than mid-November. [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2118410078445621331) [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2118421110957998414)
- @BarakRavid posted the same update in Hebrew. [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2118410367017558305)

### Oleshky Ceasefire Outcomes
- @TheStudyofWar assesses the localized Kherson Oblast ceasefire (ended 1 Nov) enabled evacuation of up to 800 civilians and delivery of humanitarian aid, underscoring Russia’s intransigence as the barrier to negotiations. [@TheStudyofWar](https://x.com/TheStudyofWar/status/2118418072805527560)

### UAV Activity Over Iran
- @hey_itsmyturn reports UAV activity over Urmia in West Azerbaijan Province. [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2118429370373042656)

### Israeli Shin Bet Leadership Comments
- @BarakRavid highlights Shin Bet head David Zini calling election funding a “strategic attack” comparable to 7 Oct and calling for his resignation. [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2118416016573120796)

### Ukrainian Drone Intercepts and Russian Incidents
- @wartranslated posts video of Ukrainian jet interceptor drone downing a Russian Geran-5 UAV. [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2118411570061676935)
- @wartranslated also reports a major gas pipeline explosion and fire in Siberia’s Kemerovo region. [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2118409760567333316)

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- @hey_itsmyturn: UAV activity over Urmia, Iran (unconfirmed). [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2118429370373042656)
- @BarakRavid (via Israeli media): Shin Bet head Zini equates election funding to 7 Oct failure (unconfirmed). [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2118416016573120796)
- @wartranslated: Russian soldier “Gordy” missing in Donbas, suspected suicide from lack of supplies (unconfirmed). [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2118407525913481551)

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will track the Roosevelt’s actual arrival timeline in CENTCOM and any follow-on Iranian or Ukrainian drone developments. ISW continues monitoring Kherson humanitarian outcomes.
